minutes.headline: Sewer Commission discussed a developer's request to connect outside the service area; no votes taken beyond minutes and adjournment.
minutes.summary: The commission discussed filling its vacancies, a possible sewer extension for a roughly 10-acre parcel mostly outside the service area, and an easement waiver request. It also covered adding online bill payment, a failed hire for the assistant to the business manager, and a commissioner's planned departure. Only the prior minutes were approved and the meeting adjourned; the bill-pay vote was deferred to the next meeting.

budget_items.what_was_said: Scope of work has been narrowed with the firm and a cost estimate is expected by the next meeting; an earlier estimate was described as a big number.

The town treasurer's office says online payment is easy to implement; concerns are that corrections for over/underpayments would fall on the business manager. Members argued it could reduce past-due balances and collection costs.

budget_items.topic: Permit and privilege fees for new connections
budget_items.what_was_said: Staff said a developer connecting would pay permit and privilege fees like any other new connection, and capacity at the Fitchburg and Leominster plants is ample.
Commissioners questioned whether more connections lower costs for others, since customers pay for usage and initial construction.
